basic_info.description: Welcome to Mission Crown! A stunning collection of extensively remodeled residences housed behind a restored historic Victorian facade. Residence 3443 is an expansive flat with soaring ceilings, open kitchen and a classic Queen Anne style turret bay window. Three bedrooms (with flexible 4th bedroom/office) and two full bathrooms provide ample flexibility of space. In-unit laundry is included. Enjoy all the charm and character of a classic San Francisco building, with modern features and updates ideal for today's living needs. The extensive building remodel includes new electrical, plumbing, seismic retrofitting and new foundations. A common roof deck provides stunning views of the downtown skyline. Experience the vibrant Mission District with world-class dining, nightlife, and numerous shopping options right at your doorstep. Easily walkable to the Valencia corridor and the bustling 20th street restaurant scene. Nearby access to public transport makes exploring the city a breeze! Reach out today to schedule your private tour.
